children: said it had developed an artificial intelligence-driven charging system that can take an electric vehicle battery from 10% to 70% in 4.5 minutes, stepping up competition over charging speeds in China's EV market, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.

The automaker said trials using a Zeekr 001 sedan and a Lynk & Co 10 hybrid showed the vehicles could reach 70% charge from 10% in four minutes and 30 seconds. Charging the battery to 97% took less than nine minutes, it added.
The system relies on algorithms that forecast battery temperatures and modify charging power accordingly, Geely
said. It will be introduced with a new version of the company's smart-charging station, which has a maximum charging output of 2,250 kilowatts.
charging technology in direct comparison with BYD
, which earlier this year introduced a system capable of charging a battery from 10% to 70% in five minutes.
Chinese EV manufacturers have been developing new battery and charging technologies as domestic demand contracts and competition increases.
, based in Hangzhou, has been working on batteries and charging infrastructure that compete with BYD's offerings. It outsold BYD
during the first two months of the year but trailed the rival in the months that followed.
